about.label: About Me
about.title: Keep Learning, Keep Growing
about.bio_1: I am currently pursuing a B.E. in Software Engineering at Hainan Normal University (enrolled Sep 2024). My coursework includes HTML5 Programming, Java Programming Fundamentals, Python Programming Fundamentals, J2EE, Data Structures & Algorithms, MySQL, Discrete Mathematics, Computer Organization, and Computer Networks. I have won the National Second Prize at the 18th China University Computer Design Competition (2025) and the University-Level Silver Award at the Internet+ Competition.
about.bio_2: In project practice, I was responsible for PPT design and production for the 'QiongYuZhiYiTong' competition project, which won the National Second Prize. I also independently built a full-stack smart store management system using Claude Code + DeepSeek-V4 Pro, with React 19 + Vite 8 on the frontend and Node.js + Express + MySQL on the backend. The system supports product management, sales tracking, data analytics, and complete C-end user experience optimization, iterated from v1.0 to v1.3 (not yet deployed — available for live demo).
about.bio_3: On campus, I served as an academic assistant at the Provincial Engineering Research Center of the School of Artificial Intelligence (2024.11 - 2025.06), won 8th place in the men's 3000m race at the 41st University Sports Meet, earned the 'Model Dormitory' honor, and led my course project team to a high score as group leader in the 'Professional Development Practice (Java Project)' course. I have a solid understanding of the complete software engineering lifecycle, strong learning ability, and good communication skills, and I am eager to further develop my engineering capabilities through an internship.
